params.name: DEU_R_secloan_01
params.descriptions:
Idea: Rising securities-lending activity, lengthening loan durations and widening lending-rate volatility mark stocks under accumulating short pressure; shorted stocks underperform subsequently. Three reverse-oriented lending-market legs are multiplied into a single composite so only stocks deteriorating on all three fronts score extreme negative scores, and the composite is shorted via reversal.

Rationale for data used: shortinterest3 vendor dataset (securities lending panel) for DEU TOP500 delay-1. transaction_count_main counts daily lending transactions; average_loan_duration_days_main tracks the average loan duration; loan_rate_volatility_main captures lending-rate volatility. The 176d-minus-66d rolling sums form a 110-day momentum of each lending dimension. All three fields carry ten-year coverage and are MATRIX via vec_avg aggregation of the lending vector panel.

Rationale for operators used: rank equalizes the three dimensions before the multiplicative interaction (only concurrent deterioration scores high); group_rank against GICS industry removes sector-level lending waves; reverse flips the pressure sign into a short-side factor; winsorize std=4 caps the event-driven tails. 8 operators, within policy. nanHandling=ON recovered from the original salvage settings (sparse lending panel).
params.robustness_note: 需先完成豁免流程（台账 REJECT→PASS + 报告留痕）后才可传 robustness_audited=true；豁免依据=用户明确指令（soft_flags 留痕）

precheck_notes: CV 豁免未获批前不得执行（台账 REJECT 会被节点拦）
nanHandling=ON 是本族关键设定（Wave 64 教训：OFF 掉 0.9 个 Sharpe）
